title: This game is your elevator to English – level 1
paragraphs: What is LangoPlay? LangoPlay is like an elevator. It can take you up to an intermediate level of English.
It helps you learn English step by step. LangoPlay takes you to a level where you know 2,500 English words.
These words are very important. They are 90% of the words people use in everyday spoken English.
With these words and basic grammar, you can talk about everyday things.
So, how can you get there? Play LangoPlay every day. Do one chapter each day. Try to get all the stars.
In the Listening section, listen to the whole chapter many times. Listen until you understand it well.
Then hide the left side of the Listening section. Translate the text into your own language. Do it many times. Try to translate the whole text perfectly.
Then go to the next chapter.
When you play, think about what you read, hear, and say. See the people, places, and situations in your head. This helps you remember new words for a longer time.
Try LangoPlay today. Start for free at langoplay.com.
